principles: Purely additive (no modification of runner, manifest, or existing test:* scripts)
Verbatim from A0 sketch (HTML+LCOV at packages/main/coverage/, .gitignore)
Simple v1 (defer CI integration and child-process instrumentation)
drivers: A0 chosen Path B requires c8 coverage to be complete
Existing runner uses worker pool — parent-c8 cannot capture child coverage without extra setup
Must not break npm test or npm run test:all

options.name: Single-process mode (--jobs 1)
cons: Only acceptable for on-demand runs, not CI hot path

rationale: A0 explicitly defers CI integration; coverage is on-demand. Single-process is simpler, accurate, matches existing invocation pattern. Wall-clock penalty is acceptable. Multi-process can be added in a follow-up if needed.

preMortem.scenario: Some smokes assume worker-pool isolation and fail serially
preMortem.trigger: npm run test:coverage exits non-zero on first failing smoke
preMortem.consequence: v1 coverage unusable until skipped or marked
preMortem.mitigation: Run test:coverage during DEV verify; tag failing smokes with skip in manifest entry; document known limitations in CHANGELOG

preMortem.trigger: Time npm run test:coverage; observe wall-clock
preMortem.consequence: Developers avoid running coverage; defeats purpose
preMortem.mitigation: If unacceptable, fall back to multi-process design as follow-up; document expected duration in CHANGELOG

preMortem.scenario: c8 v10 has breaking changes from prior major
preMortem.trigger: npm install c8 + run yields module errors
preMortem.mitigation: Pin to latest tested major in package.json; document version in CHANGELOG; verify via npm install + smoke run
